Source: The Mask 1994 1080p Remux AVC DTS-HD MA 5.1-CiNEPHiLES (Thanks!)

Debanded/zoned the intro logo; also zoned the end credits.
Fixed the dirty lines at the top and bottom using bbmod.
The Atmos audio track was encoded using Atmos-Encoder, with truehdd and DEE+wrapper.
The surround audio track was encoded with qaac (-V 127), and the commentaries were transcoded with qaac as well (-V 63).
The English subtitles were OCR'd and spell-checked.
Many thanks to @User and CiNEPHiLES for the perfect remux source.
